tags: Solid Brass Pocket Door Privacy Locks

text.description_html:
Emtek 2102-US3/US15, Polished Brass and Satin Nickel Pocket Door Privacy Lock

Split finish Emtek privacy pocket door set with polished brass exterior and satin nickel interior. The Privacy Pocket Door Lock by Emtek is an all-in-one set designed to add a privacy function to your sliding pocket doors. Privacy locks latch and have an emergency turn release on the exterior. It will fit 1-3/8 inch to 1-3/4 inch thick pocket doors. The Pocket Door Privacy Lock has a built in flip out edge pull to get the sliding door out of its pocket.

Pocket Door Privacy Lock: Locks but has access to unlock from the outside via emergency turn. Privacy locks do not offer security, they offer privacy.

Specifications for the Emtek 2102 Pocket Door Lock:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Exterior Finish: Polished Brass
  • Interior Finish: Satin Nickel
  • Height: 3-1/8"
  • Width: 2-3/8"
  • Door Thickness: Adjustable 1-3/8" to 1-3/4"
  • Emergency lock release on outside.
  • Packaged with matching finish screws and strike plate.
  • Emtek 2102 Installation Instructions (PDF)

Sold Individually
